title: Sketchpad: 1:1 priority threads & micro-commitments
content:
Purpose: quick, tactical 1:1 with Maya (IC-3 SWE) — surface top blockers, align next sprint priorities, and convert vague asks into 1–2 micro-commitments.

Meeting length: 30m (20m focused sync + 10m career/check-in)
Location: Zoom / async notes to follow in channel #eng-frontend

AGENDA (rough):
- 0–5m: lightning status — how are the two active tickets (INF-4321, RED-3410)? any surprises?
- 5–12m: blockers deep-dive (compute quota + flaky e2e) — decide action or escalate
- 12–20m: priority calibration — what to deprioritize if schedule slips (perf vs. reliability)
- 20–25m: micro-commitments & ownership — pick 1 owner per blocker with clear next step
- 25–30m: career signal check — 1 thing you want me to advocate for / 1 area you want feedback on

Notes-to-self / prompts to use:
- "Tell me what you would do if you had double the quota for a week." (tests prioritization)
- Ask: "Which of these items keeps you up at night?" (rank urgent vs important)
- If they hedge, push for a single next action: PR, triage meeting, doc, or revert.

Current state (quick brain dump):
- INF-4321: rollout blocker — prefix cache invalidation regression causing 3–5% higher latencies on tails. Maya thinks it's config drift between staging/prod. Repro: sometimes shows only after warmup >30s.
- RED-3410: e2e flakes on GPU infra during nightly runs — suspected NCCL comms drop. SRE assigned but low signal.
- Perf work (experimental batching change): branch merged to feature/perf-batching but not yet A/Bed. Risk: could increase p95 if batching window mis-sized.

Signals to listen for in conversation:
- Language: "I don't have time" vs "I need help prioritizing" (latter => do coaching).
- Ownership language: does Maya name who will do the follow-up? If not, coach to pick owner now.
- Burnout cues: shorter sentences, dropped details, dates slipping.

Decision heuristics (in-meeting):
- If blocker affects >2 customers or increases error rate: escalate to SRE lead and set concrete 24–48h mitigation
- If blocker is infra quota but workaround exists (manual cache flush), schedule follow-up and assign owner for automation in next sprint
- If perf change is risky and p95 could regress, gate behind a small canary (5–10% traffic) and keep fallback path

Proposed micro-commitments (convert to action items):
- Action A: Maya to open a short triage doc for INF-4321 by Fri 2026-04-30 with 3 hypotheses and reproduction steps. Owner: Maya. (due: 2026-04-30)
- Action B: I (Ibrahim) to loop in SRE lead (Anita Rao) and request a 1-hour deep-dive this week; include NCCL traces and recent kernel updates. (due: 2026-04-28)
- Action C: Maya to add canary gating to feature/perf-batching PR and create a rollback plan; stub PR by Mon 2026-05-04. Owner: Maya. (due: 2026-05-04)
- Action D: small career ask — Maya to draft a 200–300 word note on impact areas she wants stretch on (systems design or infra ownership). I'll review and share with Eng Directors. (due: 2026-05-10)

Potential blockers to these actions:
- Time — Maya is on rotation for on-call; we may need to reassign some work.
- SRE bandwidth — if Anita can't meet this week, escalate to me to cover.

Follow-up plan (how I'll track):
- Post-meeting: create a short checklist in the ticket INF-4321 linking the triage doc + owners.
- Slack post in #eng-frontend summarizing commitments (tag Maya + Anita + me).
- Calendar: 30m follow-up (optional) next Tue if triage doc unresolved.

Open questions to raise if time:
- Is the staging/prod config drift repeatable? who changed the runtime args last? (link to infra-change-log)
- Are we seeing correlation with recent driver updates on dedicated capacity? (check infra changelog: infra-release-2026-04-18)

Tone / coaching approach:
- Validate the friction first ("that sounds really frustrating") then move to solution orientation.
- Push gently on trade-offs: "If we prioritize reliability this sprint, which perf experiments survive?"

Draft Slack summary (post-meeting):
Hey team — quick update from my 1:1 with Maya: we surfaced a prefix cache invalidation issue (INF-4321) and e2e nightly flakes (RED-3410). Maya will draft triage doc by Fri (INF-4321). I'll pull in Anita for infra traces by Wed. We agreed to gate the perf-batching change behind a small canary and have a rollback plan. I'll post links once triage doc + canary PR are up.

Quick notes-to-self (one-liners to keep):
- Don't solve everything in meeting — aim for 2 tangible next steps.
- Praise any visible ownership, call out the impact.
- Keep career chat to 5–7m but schedule longer if they want deep coaching.

End of sketchpad. Will convert to tidy meeting notes + action list after the 1:1 and push to ticket INF-4321 and #eng-frontend.
